name: Krisp
description: Connect your meeting history to AI tools so past decisions, action items, and conversation context are easy to find and use.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Krisp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Krisp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.krisp.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Krisp MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Krisp provides these MCP tools: date_time, get_multiple_documents, get_user_preferences, list_action_items, list_activities, list_upcoming_meetings, and search_meetings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Krisp?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Krisp in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Krisp requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Krisp is developed by Krisp. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
